<nav class="topbar" aria-label="Story navigation">
  <a class="brand" href="#top" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:none">Paycheck / Personality</a>
  <div class="nav"><a href="#article">Article</a><a href="#sources">Sources</a></div>
</nav>

<header class="hero" id="top">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="eyebrow">A data story · Swiss TREE + synthetic comparison</div>
    <h1>The Paycheck Personality</h1>
    <div class="prompt">Scroll to read the article ↓</div>
    <a class="hero-link" href="#article">Start the story</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<section id="article">
  <div class="wrap teammate-copy">
    {{< include ../Story Intro.txt >}}
  </div>
</section>

</main>

<footer class="foot" id="sources">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="source-note">The article text was provided by the project team. The analysis uses the canonical TREE and synthetic comparison datasets included with this project.</p>
  </div>
</footer>

<script src="data.js"></script>
<script>
const palette = { ink: '#172826', muted: '#5f706d', green: '#215d50', coral: '#d96f50', paper: '#fffefa' };
const baseLayout = { paper_bgcolor: palette.paper, plot_bgcolor: palette.paper, font: { family: 'DM Sans, sans-serif', color: palette.ink }, margin: { l: 56, r: 20, t: 15, b: 76 }, xaxis: { tickangle: -18, automargin: true, gridcolor: '#edf0e9' }, yaxis: { zeroline: true, zerolinecolor: palette.ink, gridcolor: '#edf0e9' }, showlegend: false };
document.getElementById('overview-people').textContent = STORY_DATA.tree.n.toLocaleString();
document.getElementById('overview-episodes').textContent = STORY_DATA.tree.complete_n.toLocaleString();
document.getElementById('overview-wage').textContent = STORY_DATA.tree.median_hourly.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
Plotly.newPlot('overview-wage-chart', [{ type: 'bar', x: STORY_DATA.tree.wage_histogram.map(d => d.bin), y: STORY_DATA.tree.wage_histogram.map(d => d.count), marker: { color: palette.green }, hovertemplate: 'CHF %{x} / h<br>%{y} employment episodes<extra></extra>' }], { ...baseLayout, height: 330, margin: { ...baseLayout.margin, b: 92 }, xaxis: { ...baseLayout.xaxis, title: 'Hourly wage range (CHF / h)', tickangle: -35 }, yaxis: { ...baseLayout.yaxis, title: 'Employment episodes' } }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
Plotly.newPlot('tree-inline-chart', [{ type: 'bar', x: STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => d.trait), y: STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => d.r), marker: { color: STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => d.r >= 0 ? palette.green : palette.coral) }, error_y: { type: 'data', array: STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => d.ci), visible: true, color: palette.muted }, customdata: STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => [d.p, d.n]), hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>Pearson r: %{y:.3f}<br>p-value: %{customdata[0]:.3g}<br>n: %{customdata[1]}<extra></extra>' }], { ...baseLayout, height: 330, yaxis: { ...baseLayout.yaxis, title: 'Pearson r with log hourly wage' } }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
document.getElementById('tree-inline-table').innerHTML = '<table><thead><tr><th>Trait</th><th>Pearson r</th><th>p-value</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + STORY_DATA.tree.correlations.map(d => `<tr><td>${d.trait}</td><td>${d.r.toFixed(3)}</td><td>${d.p < .001 ? '&lt; .001' : d.p.toFixed(3)}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
const select = document.getElementById('kaggle-inline-select');
Object.entries(STORY_DATA.models).forEach(([key, model]) => { const option = document.createElement('option'); option.value = key; option.textContent = model.label; select.appendChild(option); });
function showModel(key) {
  const model = STORY_DATA.models[key];
  Plotly.react('kaggle-inline-chart', [{ type: 'bar', x: model.rows.map(d => d.trait), y: model.rows.map(d => d.beta), marker: { color: model.rows.map(d => d.beta >= 0 ? palette.green : palette.coral) }, error_y: { type: 'data', array: model.rows.map(d => 1.96 * d.se), visible: true, color: palette.muted }, customdata: model.rows.map(d => [d.p]), hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>Standardized beta: %{y:.3f}<br>p-value: %{customdata[0]:.3g}<extra></extra>' }], { ...baseLayout, yaxis: { ...baseLayout.yaxis, title: 'Standardized coefficient (95% CI)' } }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
  document.getElementById('kaggle-inline-n').textContent = model.n.toLocaleString() + ' rows · ' + model.controls_label;
  document.getElementById('kaggle-inline-table').innerHTML = '<table><thead><tr><th>Trait</th><th>Std. beta</th><th>95% CI</th><th>p-value</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + model.rows.map(d => `<tr><td>${d.trait}</td><td>${d.beta.toFixed(3)}</td><td>${(d.beta-1.96*d.se).toFixed(3)} to ${(d.beta+1.96*d.se).toFixed(3)}</td><td>${d.p < .001 ? '&lt; .001' : d.p.toFixed(3)}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
}
select.addEventListener('change', () => showModel(select.value));
showModel(select.value);
</script>
